scope: internal HTTP interface for the service layer (Spring Boot); dev, loopback, no browser clients, no CORS; /internal/v1/* requires the shared service key
server: scripts/run_api.py → uvicorn biz_aid_pipeline.api.app:app on 127.0.0.1:8000 (BIZAID_API_PORT), one worker

auth.secret: INTERNAL_AI_API_KEY environment variable (OS env first, then .env.dev); never in code or Git
auth.applies_to: /internal/v1/*; GET /health stays open for local health checks
auth.mismatch: 401 internal_auth_failed; the caller must treat it as a service configuration error, not an end-user login failure

GET /health.rule: no model, DB, Qdrant or LLM call

POST /internal/v1/query.response: service result as returned: SEARCH_LIST {request_mode, status, candidate_count, programs, natural_filter, candidate_period_unknown} or DOCUMENT_QA (RagAnswer fields + request_mode, natural_filter)

POST /internal/v1/eligibility.response: EligibilityService result as returned (contracts/schemas/eligibility.contract.json); status is never recomputed

request.company_profile: CompanySearchProfile: company_size, business_status, region, business_start_date (all optional; unknown fields 422)

POST /internal/v2/personalized-search.delegates: ServiceRuntime.personalized_search → company_conditions (code mapping) + NaturalLanguageFilterService (query only) → ProgramCandidateService (exclude_closed_on=as_of) → ProgramDiscoveryService(limit 3)
POST /internal/v2/personalized-search.company_mapping: user-approved: company_size 소상공인 → target {소상공인, 중소기업}, 중소기업 → {중소기업}; other sizes, region, business_start_date, 휴업 → unapplied_conditions; 폐업 → COMPANY_CLOSED
POST /internal/v2/personalized-search.combine: AND of company and query conditions; query targets are intersected with company targets and an empty intersection returns CONDITION_CONFLICT (never silently relaxed)
POST /internal/v2/personalized-search.response: {status: LISTED|NO_CANDIDATES|NO_INDEXED_PROGRAMS|COMPANY_CLOSED|CONDITION_CONFLICT, top_k: 3, as_of, candidate_count, programs (≤3, discovery items in rank order), applied_conditions{company, query, exclude_closed_on}, unapplied_conditions[{source, field, value, reason}], natural_filter, conflict?}
POST /internal/v2/personalized-search.rule: FastAPI never reads users/companies; Spring owns the company data and sends only these fields. The V1 /internal/v1/query behaviour is unchanged

request.company_profile: CompanyProfileSnapshot fields (stored values only; missing facts stay null)

POST /internal/v2/personalized-eligibili.delegates: ServiceRuntime.personalized_eligibility → PersonalizedEligibilityService.run: PersonalizedSearchService.search (search profile = 4 fields taken from the snapshot by code) → for each Top 3 program in rank order the existing EligibilityService.evaluate (sequential)
POST /internal/v2/personalized-eligibili.response: {search: personalized-search response, evaluations: [{rank, pblanc_id, program, evaluation_status: COMPLETED|FAILED, eligibility (existing eligibility result) | null, error_code | null}] in the same order as search.programs}
POST /internal/v2/personalized-eligibili.isolation: each program is evaluated with retrieval scoped to that pblanc_id; a PipelineError or unexpected error marks only that program FAILED with a fixed code; it is never converted to UNKNOWN or a status
POST /internal/v2/personalized-eligibili.latency: sequential; measured 161s for search + 3 evaluations on local Qwen (IMP-020); exceeds Spring AI_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT 90s, which was intentionally not raised

business_outcomes: NO_CANDIDATES, NO_INDEXED_PROGRAMS, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, NEEDS_MORE_INFO, INELIGIBLE, ELIGIBLE, LISTED, ANSWERED, COMPANY_CLOSED, CONDITION_CONFLICT are HTTP 200

errors.502: LLM output violated its contract (filter_extraction_*, eligibility_output_*, invalid evidence/profile field, rag_llm_output_*)
errors.503: llm_unavailable, llm_http_error, MySQL OperationalError, Qdrant connection error (dependency_unavailable); internal_auth_not_configured
errors.500: any other failure (internal_error or other PipelineError code)
errors.rule: no stack trace or connection detail in responses

resources: ServiceRuntime is created once in the FastAPI lifespan: LLM provider, MySQL engine pool and Qdrant client at startup, BGE-M3 Retriever on first use; closed at shutdown; Ollama is external
